# Lotus Blossom

Lotus is the blue half of Ponyville's spa twins in G4 Friendship is Magic. She and her pink sister Aloe run the Day Spa, a favorite haunt of Rarity and Fluttershy. Remember her by her sky-blue coat, pink mane and tail, blue eyes, pale lotus-flower cutie mark, white headband and collar with a pink jewel.

[![Hasbro Studios — Lotus filing Rarity's horn in Green Isn't Your Color](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2020/8/20/203657/large.jpg)](https://manebooru.art/images/203657)

**Name and voice:** Lotus Blossom is an official franchise name, used in the [Spa Pony Set merchandise](https://data.mlpmerch.com/blind-bags/set/spa-pony-set/) and the [Slice of Life credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_five). Lotus and Lotus Bloom are alternate published names, not separate identities. She speaks with a Swedish-sounding accent, voiced in English by Tabitha St. Germain. Her first speaking appearance was Bridle Gossip (S1E9, December 10, 2010).

**Other appearances:** Green Isn't Your Color (S1E20), A Friend in Deed, Ponyville Confidential, Castle Sweet Castle, Rainbow Roadtrip and Between Dark and Dawn (where the twins style the royal sisters). She also speaks in Friendship is Forever's fourth clip-show episode, Deep Tissue Memories. See the [character overview](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Spa_ponies) and [clip-show credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_nine).

## Important moments

- **Welcoming Zecora — [Bridle Gossip (S1E9)](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200198838/s01-e09-bridle-gossip):** Lotus asks Zecora for her herbal bath recipe after it cures the Mane Six, showing how Ponyville has come to appreciate the zebra rather than fear her.
- **Booking the Pony Tones — [Filli Vanilli (S4E14)](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165272/s04-e14-filli-vanilli):** The twins request a performance at their spa, contributing to Fluttershy's increasingly demanding secret singing engagements.
- **Calming the bride — [Slice of Life (S5E9)](https://www.springfieldspringfield.co.uk/view_episode_scripts.php?episode=s05e09&tv-show=my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic):** Lotus tries to soothe Matilda while styling her mane amid the chaos of a wedding moved forward by a day.
